profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary:
I'm an ambitious person. I have a lot of things I want to get done in life, and I don't really let much get in the way of what I want to accomplish. Because of this, I'm more focused on what allows me to get where I'm trying to go. 

I'm looking forward to getting exposure to new technologies as time goes on, perhaps, having a hand in developing them. I'm particularly interested in tackling automation and continuous integration.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I work to create and automate test procedures for many different products our team supports. Take in test procedures from the supplier and modify for my testing needs, which includes continuous test automation on a virtual environment and test bench environment.
positions.insights: Software Testing, Agile Methodologies and +5 skills

positions.title: Associate Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Researches, designs, develops, and tests a variety of electronic equipment and systems, including radar and radiation detection equipment; radio, television and other communications equipment and systems; circuitry components; analog and digital computers; and control and test equipment.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description: I inspect, calibrate, and run the printers made at our office. Working on them until they're ready to be shipped.

positions.title: Work Study
positions.description: Handle incoming and outgoing student and faculty packages.

honors.title: Eta Kappa Nu Honor Society
honors.description: I was inducted into the honor society based on academic excellence and good professional attributes.
honors.issuer: Issued by IEEE HKN Zeta Epsilon Chapter · Aug 2014

projects.title: 8 Bit Music
projects.description: It was long process of changing musical notes into frequencies and then in turn, changing those frequencies into the pulse time and pitch to implant them into assembly code. It was fairly long process, but had fun and interesting results.

organizations.name: Order of the Engineer
organizations.description: Joined the order to symbolize my pride in what I do.

organizations.name: IEEE
organizations.description: I was given a membership because of my induction to Eta Kappa Nu(HKN).
